# Async Behavior

Source: [wiki article 4843](../archive/4843.md); edited 2024-11-26.

<a id="wiki-4843-n1"></a>

- Start Rule's already-running policy is scoped to the same player or global entity.

<a id="wiki-4843-n2"></a>

- Restart Rule replaces contextual values including event player, attacker and victim; Do Nothing lets the running invocation finish without changing its context.
